claim_boundary: Universal intake accountability is the target; universal support is not claimed.
Exact-cell promotion requires concrete fixture, deterministic expected behavior, selected verifier, passing checks, evidence artifact, and regression test.
Blocked or unsupported cells must preserve exact missing rungs.
Release support, launch readiness, production readiness, source mutation authority, proof execution authority, training eligibility, and broad claims remain closed.
Public/demo work is paused until deeper under-the-hood utility coverage is baked.
purpose: Define the repeatable support-cell promotion machine that moves Determinex from universal intake/routing toward proof-backed utility across families, languages, tools, programs, frameworks, systems, and edge cases.
